completionDefinition: Guarded simulator review gate, checklist, and handoff are implemented as local administrator review-gate-only metadata.
Simulated preflight, write lock, operation, audit, rollback, and failure handling are explicitly reviewed.
Template Workbench shows 10T review gate while Vision Analysis and ordinary user paths do not expose review gate terms.
Actual registry write, registry mutation, publish, production writer creation, production package creation, and current User App Shell package replacement remain blocked.
Documentation, provider prompts, project-state, and scoped tests are updated to 10T.

realWriteApprovalBoundaryDecision.boundary: approval-boundary-only; no actual write, no registry mutation, no publish, no shell package replacement, no production writer
realWriteApprovalBoundaryDecision.checklistBoundary: checklist confirms owner has not authorized actual write, registry mutation, publish, shell replacement, or production writer creation and does not trigger writes
realWriteApprovalBoundaryDecision.handoffBoundary: handoff can request a future authorization phase but cannot execute registry writes or mutate registry state
realWriteApprovalBoundaryDecision.approvalBoundary: future actual write requires separate explicit owner authorization
